transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot fight what we cannot see; aggressive testing in affected cities and silent surveillance nationwide will tell us the true footprint and severity before we commit to any larger measures.

actions.rationale: We cannot fight what we cannot see; aggressive testing in affected cities and silent surveillance nationwide will tell us the true footprint and severity before we commit to any larger measures.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: The public needs to hear directly from me with the facts we have and the facts we lack; honesty now builds the trust we will desperately need if this worsens.

actions.rationale: The public needs to hear directly from me with the facts we have and the facts we lack; honesty now builds the trust we will desperately need if this worsens.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives governors, hospitals, and the public a shared operating picture and prevents rumor and panic from filling the vacuum.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives governors, hospitals, and the public a shared operating picture and prevents rumor and panic from filling the vacuum.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: PPE, tests, and ventilators are already in short supply globally; invoking the DPA now to ramp domestic production is a low-cost insurance move that pays off enormously if demand surges.

actions.rationale: PPE, tests, and ventilators are already in short supply globally; invoking the DPA now to ramp domestic production is a low-cost insurance move that pays off enormously if demand surges.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: A vaccine is the only durable exit strategy; starting a crash program now, even if the threat proves milder than feared, costs little in hindsight and could save millions if it does not.

actions.rationale: A vaccine is the only durable exit strategy; starting a crash program now, even if the threat proves milder than feared, costs little in hindsight and could save millions if it does not.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions is a proportionate early measure to slow seeding of new chains of transmission while we assess the threat.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions is a proportionate early measure to slow seeding of new chains of transmission while we assess the threat.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We will need emergency funding and possibly new statutory authority for testing, supply, and relief; aligning with Congress now avoids paralyzing delay later.

actions.rationale: We will need emergency funding and possibly new statutory authority for testing, supply, and relief; aligning with Congress now avoids paralyzing delay later.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Pre-positioning relief for households and small businesses reduces the economic damage if we later must impose restrictions, and reassures markets that we are planning ahead.

actions.rationale: Pre-positioning relief for households and small businesses reduces the economic damage if we later must impose restrictions, and reassures markets that we are planning ahead.

actions.name: defer_to_states

params.rationale: Governors know their local conditions and have public-health authority; I will give them data, guidance, and resources, and let them lead local measures rather than imposing a one-size-fits-all federal shutdown prematurely.

actions.rationale: Governors know their local conditions and have public-health authority; I will give them data, guidance, and resources, and let them lead local measures rather than imposing a one-size-fits-all federal shutdown prematurely.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, low-economic-damage intervention that can meaningfully slow transmission while we wait for clearer severity data; it's the textbook low-regret move against a growing respiratory outbreak.

actions.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, low-economic-damage intervention that can meaningfully slow transmission while we wait for clearer severity data; it's the textbook low-regret move against a growing respiratory outbreak.
